system.description:
A Mournas legend — a bride who drowned in the harbour on her wedding night and never stopped waiting at the water's edge. Witches who serve her carry a little of that patience, and a little of that grief.

  • Patron Buff (1st): Once per day, grant a touched creature (or yourself) immunity to being tracked or scried upon for 1 hour — the Hollow Bride hides what is hers. In the first round of any fight within that hour, attacks against them have Disadvantage.
  • Patron Curse (3rd): Once per day, bind a creature within 30ft to a single spoken promise (Will save negates) — if they knowingly break it within 24 hours, they take 3d6 cold damage and know exactly why.
  • Physical Change (7th): Your skin is faintly cool to the touch and you no longer cast a reflection in still water.
  • Advantage on Swim checks and on saves vs drowning or exhaustion in water.
  • You may make an unarmed claw attack dealing 1d6 damage.
  • Once per day, make a melee touch attack instead — on a hit, the target takes 2d6 cold damage and must hold their breath or gain one level of exhaustion, as the harbour water fills their lungs for a moment too long.
